Bulk MAC Address Vendor Lookup 📡

Paste MAC addresses below (one per line, any format: : - . or none). Works fully offline using a built-in IEEE vendor database (~48,000 prefixes, 2022–2024 snapshot). Also flags randomized/private MACs and unicast vs multicast, with a device-type hint.
Tick the box below to also check two online vendor APIs (maclookup.app, then macvendors.com) for more detail — each is rate-limited on its free tier, so lookups are throttled to match; if both are unreachable it falls back to the offline database automatically. The Source column always shows which one actually answered.
